julies_letter.name: Julie's Letter
julies_letter.description: Dear Jane, Happy Birthday. Come next week. I drew a map. Enjoy your birthday. Julie. The paper smells like dried roses and train soot.

birthday_present.name: A Small Present
birthday_present.description: Wrapped in city paper for a woman you have never met. It is still for her.

key_school.name: Classroom Key
key_school.description: The tag says OFFICE. Someone used it as a bookmark.

key_museum.name: Museum Key
key_museum.description: Brass, tagged SCIENCE / HISTORY / ART / MAGIC. Someone kept using the MAGIC side.

butterfly_amulet.name: Butterfly Amulet
butterfly_amulet.description: Warm even in shade. The wings do not match any insect you packed a book for.

julies_mark.name: Julie's Mark
julies_mark.description: A scrap of map-paper from a stone ring. She left these like someone leaving bread for a niece who likes to walk.

grape.name: Grape
grape.description: FOOD. The bowl in the kitchen was never just furniture.

small_manashield_potion.name: Small Manashield Potion
small_manashield_potion.description: Restore Mana when taking damage, 6 charges

small_life_steal_potion.name: Small Life Steal Potion
small_life_steal_potion.description: Steal enemy life when attacking, 6 charges

small_critical_potion.name: Small Critical Potion
small_critical_potion.description: Give your next spells 50% crit chance, 6 charges

small_stone_skin_potion.name: Small Stone Skin Potion
small_stone_skin_potion.description: Reduce damage taken from physical sources by 40%, 6 charges

small_firelash_potion.name: Small Firelash Potion
small_firelash_potion.description: Cause your Fire spells to deal damage over time

small_sparktongue_potion.name: Small Sparktongue Potion
small_sparktongue_potion.description: Cause bonus Electric damage to wet enemies

small_winterbite_potion.name: Small Winterbite Potion
small_winterbite_potion.description: Adds frost effect to water spells, slowing targets

small_stranglethorn_potion.name: Small Stranglethorn Potion
small_stranglethorn_potion.description: Your attacks Poison enemies, dealing damage over time

key_auntie_house.name: House Key
key_auntie_house.description: It looks like a key to a house...

key_generic.name: Key
key_generic.description: A key, it looks very generic

key_mine_headmaster.name: Headmaster's Key
key_mine_headmaster.description: A rusty old key with initials H.M written on it

key_mine_vault.name: Mine Vault Key
key_mine_vault.description: An old key for the Vault in the gold mine

key_mine_boss.name: Large Mine Key
key_mine_boss.description: A Large key from the goldmine

key_basement_auntie.name: Auntie's Basement Key
key_basement_auntie.description: This key looks like it has had a lot of use

snake_key.name: Snake Key
snake_key.description: A snake head is pressed in to the base.

snake_boss_key.name: Giant Snake Key
snake_boss_key.description: This key feels warm even from a cold enviroment.

bone_chip.name: Bone Chip
bone_chip.description: What is left when the yard is done.

rat_meat.name: Rat Meat
rat_meat.description: Looks tasty. It is food. Castle does not care about your standards.

poisoned_rat_meat.name: Poisoned Rat Meat
poisoned_rat_meat.description: Can poison anyone that eats it.

fire_stone.name: Fire Stone
fire_stone.description: Pocket heat. The mountain and the night both hate it.

light_stone.name: Light Stone
light_stone.description: A circle of warmth like a cheap torch.

small_water.name: Small Vial of Water
small_water.description: Drinkable. Thin. Castle's idea of hydration.

hemshade_root.name: Hemshade Root
hemshade_root.description: Bitter. You can chew it. You will not enjoy it.

white_water_cap.name: White Water Cap
white_water_cap.description: A mushroom that thinks it is a meal.

night_lich_moss.name: Night Lich Moss
night_lich_moss.description: Cold chew. A little warmth if you pretend.

savage_snakeroot.name: Savage Snakeroot
savage_snakeroot.description: Poison if you are unlucky. Food if you are hungry.

nasturtium.name: Nasturtium
nasturtium.description: Pepper-leaf. The farm grows it like a dare.

pansy.name: Pansy
pansy.description: Has mana restoring properties. Also a sad snack.

white_water_rose.name: White Water Rose
white_water_rose.description: Julie's cellar rose. Petals first, questions later.

berry.name: Wild Berry
berry.description: The forest drops these like it is trying to be kind.

pear.name: Pear
pear.description: Softer than an apple. The farm still has trees.

plum.name: Plum
plum.description: Dark fruit. Stains the log if you are careless.

peach.name: Peach
peach.description: A city fruit that should not grow here. It does.

egg.name: Egg
egg.description: Raw. The scarecrow does not explain the chickens.

milk.name: Milk
milk.description: Warm if you believe in it.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.description: Chew it and feel like a horse. Bench it and feel like Julie.

onion.name: Onion
onion.description: Makes you cry. Then you eat it anyway.

potato.name: Potato
potato.description: Castle's backbone. Raw it is a dare.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.description: A leaf that thinks it is a meal.

fish.name: River Fish
fish.description: The board said FISH HERE. Someone actually did.

bird_meat.name: Bird Meat
bird_meat.description: Crow or chicken. The county does not label.

cheese.name: Cheese
cheese.description: The shopkeep's closed door still smells of this.

butter.name: Butter
butter.description: You can eat it. Julie would not judge.

salt.name: Salt
salt.description: Mine-dust that decided to be useful.

tea_leaf.name: Tea Leaf
tea_leaf.description: Chewed, it is nothing. Steeped, it is a county.

bread.name: Bread
bread.description: Wheat and water that got their lives together.

porridge.name: Porridge
porridge.description: Breakfast for a niece who missed breakfast.

jam.name: Berry Jam
jam.description: Honey and berries. The forest in a jar.

pie.name: Fruit Pie
pie.description: Julie left the idea of this on the bench.

stew.name: Root Stew
stew.description: Carrot, potato, water. The acre in a bowl.

cake.name: Kitchen Cake
cake.description: A birthday that arrived late and still counts.

sandwich.name: Cheese Sandwich
sandwich.description: Bread, cheese, the closed shop's ghost.

roasted_root.name: Roasted Root
roasted_root.description: Hemshade after fire. Less of a sermon.

dried_apple.name: Dried Apple
dried_apple.description: Travelling food. The train should have had this.

tea.name: Cup of Tea
tea.description: The county in a cup. Heat first.

warm_milk.name: Warm Milk
warm_milk.description: Honey and milk. For nights the mountain wins.

baked_potato.name: Baked Potato
baked_potato.description: The potato after it met coal.

mushroom_skillet.name: Mushroom Skillet
mushroom_skillet.description: Onion, mushroom, butter. A closed restaurant.

fish_stew.name: Fish Stew
fish_stew.description: River and onion. The board would be proud.

forest_salad.name: Forest Salad
forest_salad.description: Lily, berry, cabbage. You can pretend it is a city lunch.

mine_lunch.name: Mine Lunch
mine_lunch.description: Jerky, bread, coal-warmth. The Headmaster's only kindness.

cider.name: Apple Cider
cider.description: Apples that decided to be a drink.

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Not food yet. The acre knows.

leather.name: Leather
leather.description: Wolf leftover. The bench has opinions.
